designTokens.title: Native services where they count.
designTokens.description: Heavy editor work runs natively, not trapped in a web view. Window management, file I/O, and terminals are native Rust services - no serialized JSON IPC bridge.

componentLibrary.title: Unmodified extensions, no fork path.
componentLibrary.description: Your VS Code extensions run unmodified - no forks, no rewrites. A compatibility host implements the VS Code extension API surface.

documentation.title: Fibers, not Promises.
documentation.description: Failures are typed, traceable, and cancellable - one supervised fiber never takes down the rest of the editor.

versionControl.title: One source tree, configured targets.
versionControl.description: Tauri uses the OS WebView on each platform - no bundled Chromium. One codebase compiles to native macOS, Windows, and Linux packages.

cicdIntegration.title: Background daemon, always running.
cicdIntegration.description: Updates, indexing, signing, and health checks run in a persistent daemon that keeps working after the main window closes.

collaboration.title: CC0. No restrictions.
collaboration.description: Fork it, ship it, build commercial products on top of it. The entire codebase is CC0 public domain - no attribution required, no compliance headaches.

features.subtitle: Native speed. VS Code compatibility. No Chromium, no compromises.
features.title: VS Code. Without Electron.

hero.subtitle: A native code editor with the soul of VS Code - and none of the browser. Built on Rust and Tauri, compatible with the extensions you already use.

1.title: Rust Core
tooltip: Mountain implements Common traits in Rust via Tauri.
Handles windows, files, terminals, process control, and gRPC IPC through the Vine protocol.
The ActionEffect system treats every operation as declarative data dispatched across layers.

2.title: Tauri UI
tooltip: Sky renders the editor interface in the OS WebView via Astro and routes Tauri events through SkyBridge to VS Code workbench APIs.
Multiple workbench layouts adapt the UI layer to different runtimes: browser proxy, Mountain-native, or Electron.

3.title: Effect-TS Services
tooltip: Cocoon and Wind use Effect-TS for typed errors, scoped resources, cancellation, and supervised concurrency.
Wind composes workbench services into Layer stacks that make dependency paths traceable at compile time - one stack per runtime target.

4.title: gRPC IPC
tooltip: Vine defines the gRPC protocol layer between Mountain, Cocoon, Air, and Grove.
Vine.proto is the canonical contract; Air, Grove, and Mountain carry their own proto files.
Every gRPC call is a typed contract - the wire format is the interface.

5.title: Extension Host
tooltip: Cocoon runs VS Code extensions via dual-track architecture:
Track A loads unmodified extHost sources for maximum compatibility,
Track B routes I/O-heavy operations to Mountain through gRPC.

6.title: Cross-Platform
tooltip: Tauri bundles to native macOS, Windows, and Linux packages using the OS WebView - no embedded Chromium.
Per-platform build configuration and binary management keep cross-compilation paths explicit rather than hidden in installer scripts.

7.title: VS Code API
tooltip: Cocoon implements the VS Code API surface through Effect-TS services: commands, workspace, terminals, webviews, language providers, and diagnostics.
The dual-track architecture preserves compatibility with published extension APIs while routing through native services.

8.title: Open Source CC0
tooltip: All 16 element repos are under CC0 1.0 Universal public domain.
No attribution required, no compliance restrictions.

Each milestone is labelled by what it represents: active source, integration work in progress, or release preparation.

current.name: Active Now
current.description: A native editor built on Rust and Tauri - no Chromium, no Electron. The active desktop path spans Mountain (backend), Cocoon (extensions), Sky (UI), and Wind (workbench), supported by Vine, Common, Echo, Air, Mist, Rest, Output, SideCar, Maintain, and Cache. Grove hosts Rust and WASM extensions in a Wasmtime sandbox, and Worker serves the web shell.

architecture.title: Under the Hood
architecture.subtitle: Each element replaces one piece of the Electron stack. All inspectable in source.

air.subtitle: Background Services Downloader Workspace Indexer
air.description:
Persistent Rust daemon. Updates, downloads, signing, and health checks outside the main window.
Staged updates with automatic rollback. Warm file index across sessions.
Replaces restart-to-update and cold-start indexing. Active.

cocoon.subtitle: Extension Host Unmodified VS Code Extensions Effect-TS Services
cocoon.description:
Node.js extension host. Runs existing VS Code extensions unmodified on the full VS Code API surface.
Every extension runs in its own supervised Effect fiber. Crashes are trapped at the supervision boundary.
Replaces the single-threaded extension host. Platform-native sandboxing planned.

common.subtitle: Shared Foundation Traits Cross-Element Types
common.description:
Pure abstract Rust crate. No working code, only abstract definitions.
Async service traits for every capability. ActionEffect treats every operation as declarative data.
Transport-agnostic. Same handler code over gRPC, IPC, WASM, or Mist. Active.

echo.subtitle: Work-Stealing Scheduler crossbeam-deque Supervised Worker Pool
echo.description:
Priority-aware work-stealing scheduler on crossbeam-deque. Lock-free queues: no mutex, no contention.
High, Normal, and Low priority tiers. Workers steal from peers, then fall back to the global queue.
Keeps UI work responsive under I/O load. Active.

grove.subtitle: WASM Sandbox Wasmtime Runtime Capability-Based Isolation
grove.description:
Rust and WASM extension host. Wasmtime sandbox: an extension can only touch what is explicitly granted.
Same VS Code API surface as Cocoon. gRPC, IPC, direct WASM calls, or Mist transports.
Complements Cocoon's Node.js path. Active.

maintain.subtitle: Build Orchestrator Configuration Release Profiles
maintain.description:
Deterministic build orchestrator for the Land ecosystem. One config file resolved through an embedded Rhai engine.
Type-safe editing of Cargo.toml, JSON5, and Info.plist. Dead-code elimination. Debug and release profiles.
Same commit, same output. Active.

mist.subtitle: Local DNS Sandbox *.editor.land Resolution Network Boundary
mist.description:
Local authoritative DNS server for the editor.land zone. Every subdomain resolves to loopback. Nothing escapes the machine.
Allowlist-based forwarding: only trusted external domains resolve. Binds to loopback only.
Network isolation for Cocoon and Air. DNSSEC signing planned.

mountain.subtitle: Native Rust Backend Tauri Replaces Electron Main Process
mountain.description:
Native Rust and Tauri backend. Implements the Common service traits: files, terminals, dialogs, processes, keychain.
Hosts the gRPC server for the extension host and sidecars. Manages application state and sidecar lifecycle.
Replaces the Electron main process. Active.

output.subtitle: Compilation Pipeline Plugin-Routed Deterministic Build
output.description:
Build orchestration for VS Code platform source. esbuild primary, Rust-native Rest selectable via environment.
Plugin-routed pipeline. Node.js API polyfills for the Tauri WebView.
Deterministic builds. Shared output for Cocoon, Sky, and Wind. Active.

rest.subtitle: TypeScript Transform Pipeline OXC Rust-Native
rest.description:
Rust-native TypeScript compilation on the OXC toolchain. Parser, transformer, and codegen in one process.
No Node.js in the hot path. Decorators, class fields, and JSX. Parallel compilation across cores.
Bundles the VS Code platform code for the extension host. Active.

sidecar.subtitle: Binary Distributor Compile-Time Target Triple Selection Per-Platform Node.js
sidecar.description:
Prebuilt Node.js binaries per target platform. Mountain selects the exact binary at compile time. No runtime detection.
Official nodejs.org downloads with checksum verification. Incremental cache across builds.
Replaces runtime detection and fallback chains. Active.

sky.subtitle: Visual UI Layer Astro Components Three Workbench Layouts
sky.description:
Declarative UI layer built on Astro. Renders the editor interface in the OS WebView.
SkyBridge routes Tauri events to VS Code workbench APIs. Conditional dynamic imports keep the bundle target-specific.
Workbench layouts for Browser, Mountain-native, and Electron. Active.

vine.subtitle: gRPC Backbone Contract-First .proto Definitions
vine.description:
The gRPC backbone of Land. Proto/Vine.proto is the canonical contract between elements.
Generates type-safe Rust clients and servers, plus a TypeScript mirror for the extension host.
Speaks between Mountain, Cocoon, Air, and Grove. Active.

wind.subtitle: Workbench Services Effect-TS Layers Native Bridges
wind.description:
Effect-TS service layer. Recreates the VS Code workbench environment inside the Tauri WebView.
Typed Tauri commands replace Electron's untyped JSON IPC bridge.
Layer stacks for Tauri, Electron compatibility, and isolated tests. Active.

worker.subtitle: Service Worker Offline Cache CSS Import Support
worker.description:
Service worker for the web shell. Offline caching: network-first for navigation, cache-first for static assets.
Intercepts CSS imports and injects link tags for VS Code's stylesheet-as-module pattern.
New-version detection with client reload. Active.
